description:
A shareable bundle of per-column analyzer assignments. Wires up OpenSearch's per-field analyzer + search_analyzer mapping for specific columns of a SearchIndex, overriding the SearchConfiguration's defaults.

Example assigning a strict acronym analyzer to the disease_code column and a fuzzy scientific analyzer to authors:

{
  "organizationName": "biomed",
  "name": "publication_columns",
  "overrides": [
    { "columnName": "disease_code", "indexAnalyzer": "biomed-acronym_exact",    "searchAnalyzer": "biomed-acronym_exact" },
    { "columnName": "authors",      "indexAnalyzer": "biomed-scientific_search", "searchAnalyzer": "biomed-scientific_search" }
  ]
}

Referenced from a SearchConfiguration's columnAnalyzerOverrides by qualified name {organizationName}-{name}. Entries whose columnName is not present in a given SearchIndex's schema are silently skipped — a single override resource can therefore apply to multiple indexes that share some column names. Cannot be deleted while referenced by any SearchConfiguration.

id.description: The unique ID of this column analyzer override.

organizationName.description: The Organization that owns this resource. Immutable after creation.

name.description: Resource name (letters, digits, underscores, must start with a letter). Combined with organizationName to form the qualified name '{organizationName}-{name}'. Immutable after creation.

overrides.description: The per-column analyzer assignments — see ColumnAnalyzerOverrideEntry.

etag.description: Synapse Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) value. Send the etag from a GET back on update; a mismatch returns 409.

createdBy.description: ID of the user that created this resource.

modifiedOn.description: When this resource was last modified.

modifiedBy.description: ID of the user that last modified this resource.
